As our operations continue to grow, we are always seeking top talent to join our winning team.

Position Summary:

Responsible for the steering wheel product development to meet the target of engineering cost, quality and timing.

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities outlined in the job description are to be used as a guideline and are not meant to be all-inclusive of the essential functions of the position. Other duties may be assigned, as necessary.

  • According to regulations, customer requirements, quotation assumptions, and JSS  product strategy, determine the product concept.
  • Define the product shape and structure for an assigned CAD designer to model.
  • Define the product drawings for an assigned CAD designer to model.
  • Note: Training will be provided on specific design guidelines for the assigned product, and will have access to unified design standards.
  • Create and maintain bill of material for the product
  • Process engineering changes, submit definitions of CAD model updates and drawing updates.
  • Create tolerance stacks for gap & flush analysis, and use them to refine the product design
  • Define master sections for drawings to analyze and track important design features
  • Define and track critical characteristics for important features, cascade them through drawings, DFMEA, and align them to our PFMEA and production systems.
  • Create and maintain DFMEA and DRBFM to analyze the potential failure of the design, and take preventive measures to avoid the failure
  • Prepare and present Design Review gates
  • Track and record lessons learned for design-related items
  • Perform root cause analysis on samples from validation testing, and support root cause analysis for quality and warranty issues.
  • Develop and manage VA/VE savings ideas
  • Submit and manage bill of material and technical definitions for RFQs
  • Participate in new business quote process by preparing/reviewing quoting BOMs and presenting tech reviews
  • Create and maintain the QTP (Qualification/Validation Test Plan) according to legal and customer specifications, and engineering test reports
  • Communication with the customer about test requirements and test results.
  • Participate in launch team meetings
  • Perform engineering activities on time to support overall project timeline

 

Ethics and Compliance:

  • Lead by example. Supervisors / managers and above are expected to set an example of high standards of ethical business conduct.
  • Help to create a work environment that values mutual respect and open communication.
  • Be a resource for others. Be available to speak with employees, contractors, suppliers and business partners about the Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and the policies applicable to their daily work.
  • Be proactive. Look for opportunities to discuss ethics and address challenging situations.
  • Respond quickly and effectively. Make sure that any problems that require your attention are treated with respect by all parties involved.
  • Know the limits of your authority. Avoid any action that exceeds the limits of your authority. Discuss with your supervisor or the Compliance Officer if you are unsure of what is appropriate (or not).
  • Delegate responsibilities, but never delegate your authority to individuals who may engage in illegal behavior or unethical activities.
  • Read the Code of Ethics and Business Conduct of Joyson Safety Systems, understand the content and sign the Code of Conduct Certification form.
  • Act in an ethical, honest, and professional manner by acting on behalf of the company and conducting business with integrity, even when making difficult decisions.
  • Complete all the online and/or onsite training scheduled in your location related to ethics and compliance topics.
  • Become familiar with Joyson Safety Systems ' Ethics and Compliance Policies.
  • Report to your Supervisor, the Executive Committee, the Compliance Department, or any of the available resources any possible violation of the Laws, the Code of Conduct, or the Company's Policies.
  • Ensure the quality and integrity of data and information related to your job position and department.

 

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No

 

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty

  • Strong technical knowledge of mechanical parts, and basic knowledge of electrical interfaces (such as wire harnesses, ECU module connections)
  • Problem solving ability
  • Detailed knowledge on automotive product development cycle
  • Familiar in tools such as DFMEA, tolerance stacks, GD&T usage on drawings
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills
  • Ability to create and present technical material to leadership or customers
  • Ability to reference technical specifications, extract relevant information, and use it to define test requests, and create engineering test reports.
  • Ability to define and improve product designs to align to technical specifications (with product training and access to design guidelines for specific product assigned)
  • Willingness to work on special projects that may be requested occasionally
  • Willingness to visit assembly plant for product or vehicle to improve DFM (design for manufacturing)
  • Willingness to handle and review physical parts and assemblies
  • Travel internationally occasionally (typically 0 to 4 times per year depending on project assigned)

 

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related major.
  • 6+ years’ experience in application engineering or automobile industry.

Position Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for leading the development and launch of automotive steering wheel electronics programs from award through production. This role serves as the primary customer interface and is accountable for achieving program objectives related to timing, quality, cost, profitability, and customer satisfaction. The Program Manager works closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Sales teams to ensure successful program execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead steering wheel electronics programs from development through launch and production. 
  • Serve as the primary customer contact for program-related activities. 
  • Manage program timing, budgets, deliverables, and profitability.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to achieve quality, cost, and launch objectives.
  • Drive issue resolution, risk management, and change management activities.
  • Support APQP, PPAP, prototype builds, validation testing, and production launches.
  • Communicate program status, risks, and recovery plans to customers and leadership.
  • Collaborate with global engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure successful program execution.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of automotive program management, engineering, or product development experience.
  • Experience with automotive electronics, steering wheel systems, controls, switches, sensors, HMI, or related products preferred.
  • Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, product launches, and customer program management.
  • Strong leadership, communication, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Tier 1 automotive supplier experience.
  • Experience working directly with OEM customers.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management training.

We are seeking an experienced Compensation & Benefits Manager to administer and support the day-to-day operations of the company's compensation and benefits programs. This role is primarily responsible for managing US employee benefits programs, including health and welfare benefits, retirement plans, leave programs, and wellness initiatives, while ensuring programs remain competitive, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. In addition, this position will also support compensation activities and initiatives.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

 Benefits Administration:

  • Oversee the administration of employee benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, 401(k), FSA/HSA, wellness, leave of absence, and voluntary benefits.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, and related requirements.
  • Lead annual open enrollment activities and employee benefits communications.
  • Partner with brokers, consultants, carriers, and third-party administrators to ensure effective administration and service delivery.
  • Evaluate existing benefits programs and recommend enhancements to ensure competitiveness, cost-effectiveness, and alignment with business needs.
  • Monitor benefits utilization, program performance, and costs, providing recommendations to enhance employee experience while managing expenses.
  • Design, recommend, and implement new benefit plans and program improvements.
  • Monitor administrative costs of benefit programs and recommend cost-containment strategies, alternative funding approaches, and process improvements.
  • Assist with benefits budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of required reporting, filings, audits, and regulatory fees.
  • Coordinate and support benefits audits, compliance testing, and regulatory reporting activities.
  • Review monthly vendor invoices and reconcile benefit-related billing.
  • Conduct benefits benchmarking and participate in industry surveys to evaluate market competitiveness and emerging trends.
  • Analyze benefits data and trends, forecast future needs, and develop recommendations for management review.
  • Develop employee communications, presentations, educational materials, and benefit guides to improve understanding and utilization of available programs.
  • Provide training, guidance, and customer support to employees, managers, and HR partners regarding benefits programs and policies.
  • Maintain accurate benefits records and ensure data integrity within HRIS, payroll, and benefits administration systems.

 

Compensation Administration

  • Participate in compensation surveys and analyze market trends to support pay decisions and salary structure development.
  • Support compensation and benefits programs, including salary administration, market pricing, and annual compensation planning.
  • Prepare compensation reports, metrics, and analyses for HR leadership and business management.

 

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of employee benefits programs, including health, retirement, disability, leave, and voluntary benefits.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and HRIS/benefits administration systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate plan performance, costs, and market trends.
  • Experience managing vendors, reviewing benefit proposals (RFPs), and negotiating service agreements.
  • Working knowledge of benefits laws and regulations, including ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, and related compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting annual compensation processes, including merit reviews, salary planning, incentive administration, and compensation governance.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and provide outstanding employee support.

 

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resource management or related field, and 5 - 7years of related benefits or employee benefits administration and compensation experience.  
  • SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP, CEBS or CCP professional designations preferred.

 

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
